landingLinks.text: OFFLINE PRACTICEOne local player versus seven explicitly labeled practice bots for eight minutes.
SOLO WAVE PRACTICELocal solo wave defense with automatic recovery. No teammates or online session.

findings.summary: Lobby reachability is automated; composition and visual quality are not approved.
Authoritative forward, strafe, jump, and landing mechanics were observed; cadence, weight, animation, and feel still require human play.
This live room covers only the selected preset roster; the four role presets and every weapon family still require parameterized runtime coverage and human weapon-contact review.

Authority activation counters and Blink displacement are observed, but bounce/weight, smoke radius and smoothness, victim readability, damage, and each role-specific ability set still require dedicated proof and human play.
Authority damage, kill, and respawn were observed; headshot readability, kill-banner quality, animation, audio, and feel remain human-review items.
The hold-Tab scoreboard is present; opacity, density, scale, and visual fit still require human review.
This stage observes browser refresh/rejoin only. It does not exercise or judge the product secure-resume path.
Performance sampling spans the scripted load, but remains headless two-client evidence and cannot stand in for the required 2/4/8 combat matrix or human hardware experience.
HUD ability text clips in 3 measured viewport occurrences.
Practice launches, but it still identifies as Iron Bastion while online uses Inkfall Foundry; Practice/online convergence is not complete.
